name: etms-offline-driver
description: As etms-on-time, but the driver app loses its connection on arriving at pickup 1 and gets it back at pickup 3. The taps at pickups 1 and 2 are queued and replayed shuffled, every second one twice, in batches of 3 (R6). The final state must equal etms-on-time's; every event is stored once; no notification is duplicated.
